posts.title: Getting unstuck
posts.description: It’s been a few years since I last published a coherent photographic project. The last one was “Where the Story Begins”, which attempted to tell the story of the sometimes chaotic early days of T.’s and my relationship and marriage. After we got married, we focused hard on building a life in London, and then we had kids.

posts.title: AI
posts.description: Forgot to mention that the book The Nerd Reich , by Gil Durán, is a great (if depressing) read if you’re curious about the politics behind the big American AI labs. (Thanks to Derek Wessmann for the idea of hand-written posts!)

posts.title: My own corner of the Fediverse
posts.description: I joined Mastodon in 2019, and right off the bat, I was very intrigued by the possibility of running your own instance under your own domain. I originally wanted to setup an instance for A Possible Space, similar to what Panic or Tapbots have done.
